notes: Official Begeman 1987 thesis is image-only, but Hoekstra, van Albada & Sancisi 2001 republishes exact vector radial H I profiles. Begeman-linked panels recovered for NGC2903 (30 vertices), NGC5033 (23), and NGC5371 (10), with native vector x-axis R/Rout and printed log10 Sigma_HI y-axis calibration. NGC6503 is excluded from Be87 recovery because Hoekstra Table 1 attributes its profile to Broeils 1992b + Wevers 1984 rather than Begeman. Three recovered profiles remain candidate-level pending exact Rout-to-physical-radius provenance.

Be91 Table 1/prose maps all five targets to original observing papers. Wevers et al. 1986 is a 157-page image-only scan with zero vector drawings. DDO170 (Lake et al. 1990), NGC3109 (Jobin & Carignan 1990), and UGC02259 (Carignan et al. 1988) preserve searchable article text but their radial H I surface-density distributions are figure-only (DDO170 Fig. 5; NGC3109 Fig. 6; UGC2259 Fig. 5), not numerical radial tables. No raster digitization performed.

Broeils 1992 is a valid original observing-source branch for six frozen galaxies. The official Groningen record describes a 255-page thesis, but the live Pure attachment is only a 3-page non-target wrapper. Bounded legacy Groningen directory and Wayback wildcard recovery found no full dissertation payload. No raster digitization performed.

Fraternali et al. 2011 explicitly derives gas density versus radius by deprojecting total H I maps. NGC891 uses Oosterloo, Fraternali & Sancisi 2007; its public arXiv source has no data arrays or numeric radial profile candidate, and the relevant H I assets are map/figure products. NGC7814 uses Kamphuis 2008; the full 160-page Groningen thesis is public and native-text searchable, but its four NGC7814 numeric candidates are contents/sample-global/cube-parameter material rather than radius-by-radius Sigma_HI rows. Fr11's published H I surface-density panels are raster-dominant. No raster digitization or map deprojection performed.

UGC09037 and UGC12506 recovered from Hallenbeck et al. 2014 Figure 9 native IDL EPS as filled-circle radial H I samples with matching vector error bars. 32 and 39 radial rows respectively; no raster digitization. Both are calibration galaxies. Later fit-derived R_HI values are advisory and were not substituted for the native profile.

Le14 split by original H I provenance. UGC04483 recovered as 10 exact source-native Figure-6 whole-galaxy radial HI points via Lelli et al. 2012b. NGC4068 redirects to Swaters et al. 2002/WHISP, whose historical atlas target figures were already recovered and audited as raster-dominant with no exact numeric/vector profile route. Do not reopen Sw02 absent its reopen condition.

Spekkens & Giovanelli 2006 is a direct aperture-synthesis H I observing source and explicitly derives face-on radial Sigma_HI(r) profiles. The arXiv package has no data-like arrays; the five frozen-target summary EPS assets (f5s, f7s, f8s, f9s, f10s) contain colorimage raster payloads with no recoverable profile path geometry. No raster digitization performed.

Exact historical WHISPI atlas recovered from Wayback; all 13 targets mapped to exact embedded figures; all 13 figure blocks classified raster-dominant with no exact vector profile evidence.

Swaters et al. 2009 states that its sample basis is Swaters et al. 2002 Paper I and that the H I observations on which its rotation curves are based are discussed in Paper I. The direct H I acquisition route is therefore Sw02, already audited through the recovered original atlas.

Trachternach et al. 2009 is the original H I synthesis observing paper for D564-8 and D631-7. Target main figures 11136fg3.ps and 11136fg5.ps are source-native vector GIPSY tilted-ring kinematic plots, not H I surface-density profiles. Appendix summary panels 11136fA4.ps and 11136fA9.ps are moment/PV map composites with embedded raster image operators; channel maps are likewise raster image streams. No target radius-by-Sigma_HI table or exact radial-density vector asset was found. Parser H/I string hits in channel-map files were verified as encoded image-stream false positives. No raster digitization or map-to-profile reconstruction performed.

van der Hulst et al. 1993 explicitly publishes radial H I surface-density distributions in Figure 2 for the resolved VLA sample, including UGC128, UGC5005, UGC5750 and UGC6614. The public DRUM journal copy preserves those radial values as plotted scan content; Table 2 contains summary scalars rather than radius-by-radius arrays. No raster digitization performed.
43-galaxy WSRT atlas explicitly contains radial HI profiles; CDS has no radial Sigma_HI table; arXiv has only two sample atlas pages; historical full-atlas link dead; bounded publisher route blocked.

Paper I shows dB01 is not a single original H I source. F571-8 redirects to dB96; UGC05750 and UGC06614 redirect to van der Hulst et al. 1993 (VH93); UGC11557 redirects to Swaters 1999/WHISP lineage; D631-7 has no resolved H I in Paper I and must follow its separate Lelli Tr09 route.

dB02 explicitly says its gas component uses H I surface densities from the references in Table 1. DDO64 maps to Stil 1999; the public Stil & Israel 2002 Paper-I source package contains DDO64's 2-D H I column-density map but no target-specific radial H I profile text or machine-readable radial profile candidate. UGC1281 and UGC4278 map to Swaters 1999/WHISP; UGC5005 maps to VH93; NGC100 has no dB02 source code and must follow its separate Lelli Rh96 route.

Five frozen dB96 targets now have public atomic-HI analytic profiles from Jadhav & Banerjee 2019: F568-3, F568-V1, F574-1, F583-1, F583-4. Remaining unresolved targets are F565-V2, F571-8 and F571-V1 only; do not reopen the already recovered five.
